status: CAD proposal; custom mechanical parts are not released for fabrication

motor.name: Bare QSH8618-96
motor.rear_shaft_bore_thread: Not established by STEP; do not assume an M3 thread

mount.concept: Four removable support posts attached through the existing front flange; a rear adapter plate carries the original PCB hole pattern
mount.adapter_material: 6061-T6 aluminum; bonding/isolation and fastener contact require mechanical/electrical review
mount.long_post_thread: M5; thread engagement and shared machine-mount fastening require mechanical approval

encoder.sensor: U18 AS5047P, top side at PCB origin
encoder.magnet: Custom diametrically magnetized NdFeB cylinder, diameter 8 mm by 6 mm; candidate grade N48SH
encoder.holder_attachment: Concentric locating pilot and bonded flat shaft-end joint; adhesive, tolerances, retention and overspeed qualification are unresolved
encoder.note: Magnet size/grade is a candidate requiring supplier field-versus-gap and temperature data; the stock PD86 magnet is not assumed compatible. No measured magnetic qualification.

unresolved: Manufacturer confirmation that the ordered QSH8618-96 variant matches the supplied STEP, including recessed rear shaft and bore
Approval of front-flange shared fastening, long-post strength/stiffness, adapter tolerances and fastener lengths
Stocked magnet selection and guaranteed field over the full tolerance/temperature range
Holder attachment, adhesive and mechanical retention/spin qualification
